entries.title: Proverbs 18:1
segments: He that separateth himself seeketh [his own] desire, And rageth against all sound wisdom.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:2
segments: A fool hath no delight in understanding, But only that his heart may reveal itself.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:3
segments: When the wicked cometh, there cometh also contempt, And with ignominy [cometh] reproach.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:4
segments: The words of a man's mouth are [as] deep waters; The wellspring of wisdom is [as] a flowing brook.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:5
segments: To respect the person of the wicked is not good, [Nor] to turn aside the righteous in judgment.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:6
segments: A fool's lips enter into contention, And his mouth calleth for stripes.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:7
segments: A fool's mouth is his destruction, And his lips are the snare of his soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:8
segments: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, And they go down into the innermost parts.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:9
segments: He also that is slack in his work Is brother to him that is a destroyer.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:10
segments: The name of Jehovah is a strong tower; The righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:11
segments: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, And as a high wall in his own imagination.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:12
segments: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty; And before honor [goeth] humility.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:13
segments: He that giveth answer before he heareth, It is folly and shame unto him.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:14
segments: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; But a broken spirit who can bear?

entries.title: Proverbs 18:15
segments: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; And the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:16
segments: A man's gift maketh room for him, And bringeth him before great men.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:17
segments: He that pleadeth his cause first [seemeth] just; But his neighbor cometh and searcheth him out.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:18
segments: The lot causeth contentions to cease, And parteth between the mighty.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:19
segments: A brother offended [is harder to be won] than a strong city; And [such] contentions are like the bars of a castle.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:20
segments: A man's belly shall be filled with the fruit of his mouth; With the increase of his lips shall he be satisfied.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:21
segments: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; And they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:22
segments: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, And obtaineth favor of Jehovah.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:23
segments: The poor useth entreaties; But the rich answereth roughly.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:24
segments: He that maketh many friends [doeth it] to his own destruction; But there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
